governance_rule: Constitutional Invariant 075: Pre-Registered Continuous Temporal Window & Anti-Asymmetry Law
constitutional_rationale: Single-instant evaluations are vulnerable to transient curve crossings. All fidelity floors, relative gains, and stability bounds must hold as an infimum across a continuous temporal window [1.0/gamma, 1.5/gamma]. If the curve drops below threshold at any point in the window, the candidate is killed.
principles: Thresholds must be strictly numeric scalars pre-registered before experimental execution
Post-hoc threshold adjustments are strictly prohibited
Single-instant snapshots are prohibited; tests must evaluate the infimum over a temporal window
Ambiguity fails closed: unmeasured or borderline metrics default to KILL/FAIL
Every kill condition must define metric, floor/ceiling, time horizon window, and adversarial baseline
